_comment: Person records judged by hand from their publication titles, re-labelled
2026-09-21 after the previous set was spent: acting on what the detector
found repaired five of its seven positives, leaving nothing to measure.
HOW A RECORD GOT HERE, because it decides what can be computed from it.
Every record carries the arm that selected it:
flagged      the detector reported it (score >= 0.3, employer check off).
These measure PRECISION. They cannot measure recall: they
are what the detector found, so it found all of them.
independent  selected by signals the detector does not use -- a career
span of 45 years or more, or work spanning three OpenAlex
domains or six fields. These can measure RECALL, because
nothing about the detector decided to look here.
random       an unbiased draw from everybody with enough papers. These
give the base rate and catch what both of the others miss.
The previous set was drawn entirely from the detector's own candidates, so
its 86% recall only ever meant: of the conflations the detector pointed at,
it pointed at 86%. Arms exist so that number cannot be quoted again.
WHAT conflated MEANS: reading the titles shows work belonging to more than
one person, however small the minority. Whether the split tool can act on
it is a different question -- several of these hold a single intruder
paper, which it cannot -- and keeping that out of the label is what lets
precision and recall mean anything.
unsure is scored by nothing. It is for records where the reading is
genuinely open, and forcing them into a bucket would be inventing ground
truth. not_a_person is a different defect that happened to surface here.
Ids belong to this corpus snapshot. scripts/measure_conflation.py reports
what is missing and what has since been repaired rather than quietly
dropping it, because a shrinking benchmark flatters every change made to it.
ADDED 2026-09-21, second pass: nine records the temporal-break signal found
that the group-ratio score scored at or below 0.29. Their arm is `flagged`,
because the break is part of the detector now -- they measure its precision
and must never count towards its recall. cc175355 is kept deliberately: a
25-year gap inside one career in Tibetan philology, and the clearest false
positive this signal produces.
2026-09-24 corrections, all on evidence the original title-only reading did not
use: 15b2b2f9 and 945c7f07 moved from unsure to one_person on per-paper
institutions (both halves name the same employer); 621360ef and 6c37bfe1
annotated as split and unverifiable; 45c81cf8 added as conflated in the
independent arm, found by dedupe's co-author overlap and missed by the detector.
labelled_at is left at 2026-09-21. 945c7f07 was split after that date, but
the repair rule applies only to conflated labels, so as one_person it is
measured on what it holds now; the other changed records were not repaired.
